notes: 02: only <title> is fetched via title-fetch.js; no description, favicon, or preview image collected. 03: title is editable before/after save, but description is never collected and no description field exists. 04: edit covers url/title/notes/tags only; no description field. 06: duplicate url returns 409 with existingId and a warning, but the UI only offers 'Save anyway' (confirmDuplicate creates a duplicate); it does not converge the user to editing the existing bookmark. 07: list items show title/url/notes/tags but no favicon and no description. 10: tags are entered as a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete of existing tags (a /api/tags endpoint feeds only the filter dropdown). 12: search is LIKE over title/url/notes/tag-name (description field absent). 14: search treats '#tag' literally; no #-tag syntax parsing. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised-group parsing; q is a single LIKE. 16: quoted phrases are not handled as exact matches. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag or view. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: list is fixed ORDER BY created_at DESC; no user-selectable sort key. 23: notes are stored and displayed but escaped as plain text (escapeHtml), not rendered as markdown. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. 26-28: no archive flag/state or archived-only view. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no user display settings (sort/items/font size).
